role_depth_score.formula: 100 * (0.2*f_ok + 0.45*c_ok + 0.35*a_ok); counts exclude shared-literacy resources (>30 roles) and conditional-flag edges. Cascade: core resources count 0.5 toward the foundational target, advanced count 0.5 toward the core target.
